title.zh: 将塔威塔威省萨帕萨帕市镇巴纳兰描笼涯Banaran小学命名为Datu Ismael Yusop纪念中央小学的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Banaran Elementary School in Barangay Banaran, Municipality of Sapa-Sapa, Province of Tawi-Tawi, as the Datu Ismael Yusop Memorial Central Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Banaran Elementary School in Barangay Banaran, Municipality of Sapa-Sapa, Province of Tawi-Tawi, as the Datu Ismael Yusop Memorial Central Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Banaran tại Barangay Banaran, Đô thị Sapa-Sapa, Tỉnh Tawi-Tawi thành Trường Tiểu học Tưởng niệm Trung tâm Datu Ismael Yusop
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Banaran ในบารังไกย์ Banaran เทศบาล Sapa-Sapa จังหวัด Tawi-Tawi เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษาอนุสรณ์กลาง Datu Ismael Yusop
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Banaran di Barangay Banaran, Kotamadya Sapa-Sapa, Provinsi Tawi-Tawi menjadi Sekolah Dasar Memorial Pusat Datu Ismael Yusop
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Banaran di Barangay Banaran, Perbandaran Sapa-Sapa, Wilayah Tawi-Tawi kepada Sekolah Rendah Memorial Pusat Datu Ismael Yusop

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6704_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Banaran Elementary School in Barangay Banaran, Municipality of Sapa-Sapa, Province of Tawi-Tawi, is hereby renamed as the Datu Ismael Yusop Memorial Central Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
